name: Bionic Reading & Fonts
author: patatasbravasch-arch
description: Bionic reading, typography, toolbar controls, FF think fix, and LumiRealm font compatibility. Bionic now crosses LumiRealm's open Shadow DOM boundary and applies the selected font to ordinary prose inside HTML islands while excluding code, controls, SVG, and other protected elements. Deep diagnostic retained. Ken alert remains disabled; personas permission retained.
